description: List the checkpoints for a single fine-tuning job.

schema.description: The ID of the fine-tune job to list checkpoints for

FineTuneCheckpoint.description: A checkpoint available for a fine-tuning job.

checkpoint.description: Canonical artifact selector for checkpoint download requests.

checkpoint_type.description: Display label for the checkpoint, including the final or intermediate checkpoint step.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the checkpoint was created.

object_id.description: Together model registry object ID for the checkpoint artifact (e.g. `ml_...`).

object_name.description: Together model registry name for the checkpoint artifact, formatted as `<project_slug>/<checkpoint_name>`.

object_revision_id.description: Together model registry revision ID for the checkpoint artifact (e.g. `rv_...`).

path.description: Storage path for the checkpoint artifact.

step.description: Step represented by the checkpoint; final checkpoints use the shipped model step.
